unit: Evans Center for Interdisciplinary Biomedical Research (ECIBR)

labs.lab_name: Evans Center for Interdisciplinary Biomedical Research
labs.pi_title: Director, Evans Center for Interdisciplinary Biomedical Research (per bu-crem.json's faculty list: Katya Ravid, DSc, Dept of Medicine, Hematology & Medical Oncology)
labs.research_summary: Promotes interdisciplinary biomedical research via 'Affinity Research Collaboratives' (ARCs) -- multi-investigator teams on topics like musculoskeletal health, fibrosis/thrombosis, TB/respiratory pathogens, women's reproductive health, and biomarker data science.
labs.join_notes: Joining an ARC: contact Dr. Katya Ravid or Robin MacDonald per the 'Joining an ARC and Incentives' page.
labs.notes: ECIBR is a cross-cutting program hub, not a department of independent PI-led labs: it organizes multi-PI 'ARC' teams drawing investigators from across BU Medical Campus, Boston Medical Center and the Charles River Campus. The people_url given (bumc.bu.edu/medicine/faculty/directory/) is the whole Dept of Medicine directory, not filterable to Evans-Center-affiliated people specifically -- not crawled here to avoid recording the entire Department of Medicine under this one target. Each ARC's own participating PIs would need their own department's source file.
